pages.title: Topological Die
pages.text: A die of topologically protected logic, cut from a braided wafer. Its anyon braids survive the cut because topology does not depend on where the edge is. It is grey and unremarkable to look at, which belies how hard it is to break.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Planck-Scale Cutter, I diced a Topological Logic Wafer, worried I would cut through the braids. Each die simply formed new protected edges where I had sliced.
Made in $(item)Planck-Scale Cutter$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Topological Matter.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Topological Processor.
